parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of durable plastic, typically small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid soap or lotion from the container.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the internal pump mechanism, made of plastic and designed to channel liquid upward.
parts.Functional_description: It transfers the mechanical force from the lid to the pump and directs the liquid through the nozzle.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly with the lid during pressing but remains mostly stationary relative to the base.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, typically made of glass or transparent plastic, with a rectangular shape.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the liquid soap or lotion and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during operation and serves as the main reservoir.
